ask: Write up our guide to keeping a sourdough starter alive as a blog post, with this photo on top: https://cdn.example.com/starter.jpg

arguments.title: How to keep a sourdough starter alive
arguments.content:
A starter is flour, water and patience. Here is the routine we use in the bakery.

## Feed it on a schedule

Once a day at room temperature...

## Read the signs

Bubbles, a domed top and a sour smell mean it is ready...
arguments.excerpt: The daily routine we use in the bakery, and the three signs your starter is ready.
